mapper.sql: t.id, t.tag_name, t.tag_type, t.description, t.create_time, t.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT , d.dict_name AS tag_type_name, COALESCE(rt_cnt.cnt, 0) AS usage_count FROM t_s_tag t LEFT JOIN t_s_dict d ON d.dict_type = 'tag_type' AND d.dict_code = t.tag_type AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tag_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_tm_resource_tag WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY tag_id ) rt_cnt ON rt_cnt.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagName}, '%')
AND t.tag_type = #{tagType}
ORDER BY t.id DESC
